text:
### Escalation & Approval  
| Risk Score | Approval Required | Timeline |
|---|---|---|
| **1–5 (Low)** | Department Head | 10 days |
| **6–12 (Medium)** | Head of Risk | 5 days |
| **13–18 (High)** | Risk Committee + Exec | 2 days |
| **19–25 (Critical)** | Board + CEO | 24 hours |

raw_entities.description: Low-risk scoring band (1–5) requiring Department Head approval within 10 days. This threshold defines the lower end of the risk escalation matrix for governance decisions.
context: Risk Score | 1–5 (Low) | Approval Required | Department Head | 10 days

raw_entities.description: Medium-risk scoring band (6–12) requiring Head of Risk approval within 5 days. This threshold escalates decisions beyond department level to the risk function.
context: Risk Score | 6–12 (Medium) | Approval Required | Head of Risk | 5 days

raw_entities.name: Risk Score High
raw_entities.description: High-risk scoring band (13–18) requiring Risk Committee and Executive approval within 2 days. This threshold triggers committee-level governance oversight.
context: Risk Score | 13–18 (High) | Approval Required | Risk Committee + Exec | 2 days

raw_entities.name: Risk Score Critical
raw_entities.description: Critical-risk scoring band (19–25) requiring Board and CEO approval within 24 hours. This threshold represents the highest escalation level with immediate decision requirements.
context: Risk Score | 19–25 (Critical) | Approval Required | Board + CEO | 24 hours
